絡.name: Entwine
絡.meaning: <radical>Thread</radical> for <radical>each</radical> person, all knotted together. They <kanji>entwine</kanji>.
絡.reading: Caught on a rack of lamb, らく. 連絡 is contact.

募.name: Recruit
募.meaning: <radical>Grass</radical>, the <radical>sun</radical>, something <radical>big</radical> and <radical>power</radical>. At sunset you gather big strong people: <kanji>recruit</kanji>.
募.reading: Row out in a boat, ぼ. 募集 is recruitment.

昇.name: Rise
昇.meaning: The <radical>sun</radical> over a <radical>measuring box</radical>. The sun climbs up the ruler: <kanji>rise</kanji>.
昇.reading: Like the start of a show, しょう. 上昇 is a rise; 昇る to rise.

巨.name: Giant
巨.meaning: A carpenter's square, the biggest tool in the shop. <kanji>Giant</kanji>.
巨.reading: A giant statue in Kyoto, きょ. 巨大 is huge.

震.name: Quake
震.meaning: <radical>Rain</radical> over a <radical>dragon</radical>. The dragon wakes in the storm and the ground starts to <kanji>quake</kanji>.
震.reading: It knocks your shin, しん. 地震 is an earthquake.

触.name: Touch
触.meaning: A <radical>horn</radical> and an <radical>insect</radical>. The bug's antennae reach out to <kanji>touch</kanji>.
触.reading: It gets a shock, しょく. 触る is to touch.

依.name: Depend
依.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> and <radical>clothes</radical>. You <kanji>depend</kanji> on your clothes to keep warm.
依.reading: An eel, い, doesn't. 依頼 is a request.

籍.name: Register
籍.meaning: <radical>Bamboo</radical>, a <radical>plow</radical> and <radical>long ago</radical>. Farmers' names written on bamboo long ago: the <kanji>register</kanji>.
籍.reading: Kept in a sack of rice, せき. 国籍 is nationality.

汚.name: Dirty
汚.reading: "Oh!" お, you say in disgust. 汚い is dirty (きたない).

傾.name: Lean
傾.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> <radical>around</radical> the corner. They <kanji>lean</kanji> over to look.
傾.reading: Balancing a cake, けい. 傾向 is a tendency; 傾く to lean.

跡.name: Tracks
跡.meaning: A <radical>foot</radical> with a <radical>top hat</radical> and marks <radical>slide</radical>ing off a <radical>barb</radical>. Footprints left behind: <kanji>tracks</kanji>.
跡.reading: Leading to a sack of rice, せき. 遺跡 is ruins; 跡 a trace (あと).

駐.name: Park
駐.meaning: A <radical>horse</radical> and its <radical>master</radical>. Tie the horse up: <kanji>park</kanji> it.
駐.reading: Give it a chew toy, ちゅう. 駐車場 is a car park.

紹.name: Introduce
紹.meaning: <radical>Thread</radical> and <radical>summon</radical>. Call two people and tie them together: <kanji>introduce</kanji>.
紹.reading: At a show, しょう. 紹介 is introduction.

雇.name: Hire
雇.meaning: A <radical>door</radical> over a <radical>turkey</radical>. <kanji>Hire</kanji> a turkey to guard the door.
雇.reading: Or a cobra, こ. 雇う is to hire; 雇用 employment.

替.name: Replace
替.meaning: Two <radical>husband</radical>s over the <radical>sun</radical>. One comes in as the other leaves: <kanji>replace</kanji>.
替.reading: かえる: swap with a car ... eh, ru? 替える is to replace; 両替 money exchange.

贈.name: Gift
贈.meaning: A <radical>shell</radical> and <radical>formerly</radical>. Money you once had, now given away: a <kanji>gift</kanji>.
贈.reading: An elephant, ぞう. 贈り物 is a present.

薄.name: Thin
薄.reading: Brewed by a hacker, はく. 薄い is thin.

奥.name: Interior
奥.meaning: A <radical>helmet</radical> with <radical>rice</radical> inside and something <radical>big</radical>. Deep in the <kanji>interior</kanji> of the storeroom.
奥.reading: おく: an ogre lives in there. 奥 is the inner part; 奥さん wife.

詰.name: Pack
詰.reading: つめる: pack a tsu-melon. 詰める is to pack.

双.name: Pair
双.reading: Two soda cans, そう. 双子 is twins (ふたご).

刺.name: Stab
刺.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical> in a <radical>helmet</radical> and a <radical>knife</radical>. A thorny tree: it will <kanji>stab</kanji> you.
刺.reading: A sheep, し, yelps. 刺身 is sashimi (さし); 名刺 business card.

悩.name: Worry
悩.reading: なやむ: "nah, yam"? You can't decide. 悩む is to worry. のう in compounds.

荒.name: Wild
荒.meaning: <radical>Grass</radical>, <radical>deceased</radical> and a <radical>river</radical>. Dead grass by a dry river: <kanji>wild</kanji> land.
荒.reading: あらい: "ah, rye", even the rye grows wild. 荒い is rough. こう in compounds.

硬.name: Hard
硬.reading: A koala, こう, bites it. 硬い is hard; 硬貨 a coin.

埋.name: Bury
埋.reading: Your microphone, まい, too. 埋める is to bury.

袋.name: Bag
袋.meaning: A <radical>substitute</radical> over <radical>clothes</radical>. Cloth used as a <kanji>bag</kanji>.
袋.reading: ふくろ: "who crow"s from inside the bag? 袋 is a bag; 手袋 gloves.

封.name: Seal
封.reading: Put it on a food truck, ふう. 封筒 is an envelope.

賢.name: Wise
賢.meaning: A <radical>retainer</radical>, a <radical>stool</radical> and a <radical>shell</radical>. The retainer saves money: <kanji>wise</kanji>.
賢.reading: Ken, けん, is wise. 賢い is clever.

腕.name: Arm
腕.meaning: <radical>Moon</radical> (flesh) and <radical>address</radical>. The limb that writes addresses: your <kanji>arm</kanji>.
腕.reading: Wave a wand, わん, with it. 腕 is うで; 腕時計 a wristwatch.

床.name: Floor
床.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical> under a <radical>canopy</radical>. Wooden boards: the <kanji>floor</kanji>.
床.reading: Dance for the show, しょう. 床 is floor (ゆか).

柔.name: Soft
柔.meaning: A <radical>spear</radical> over a <radical>tree</radical>. A spear made of green wood bends: <kanji>soft</kanji>.
柔.reading: Like a juice box, じゅう. 柔道 is judo; 柔らかい soft.

殿.name: Lord
殿.meaning: A <radical>flag</radical>, <radical>together</radical> and a <radical>weapon</radical>. Guards stand together under the flag: the <kanji>lord</kanji>'s hall.
殿.reading: The dentist, でん, visits the palace. 宮殿 is a palace; 殿 Lord (との).

濃.name: Thick
濃.reading: Write it in your notebook, のう. 濃い is thick, dark (こい).

肩.name: Shoulder
肩.meaning: A <radical>door</radical> over <radical>moon</radical> (flesh). The part you push a door open with: <kanji>shoulder</kanji>.
肩.reading: かた: carry a tub on your shoulder. 肩 is shoulder.

零.name: Zero
零.meaning: <radical>Rain</radical> by <radical>order</radical>. Ordered rain, but <kanji>zero</kanji> drops fall.
零.reading: Zapped by a ray gun, れい. 零 is zero.

泊.name: Stay Overnight
泊.meaning: <radical>Water</radical> and <radical>white</radical>. White sheets and a bath: <kanji>stay overnight</kanji>.
泊.reading: Booked by a hacker, はく. 泊まる is to stay; 一泊 one night.

甘.name: Sweet
甘.meaning: A <radical>cross</radical> over <radical>twenty</radical>: a mouth with something inside. <kanji>Sweet</kanji>.
甘.reading: あまい: "ah, my!" so sweet. 甘い is sweet. かん in compounds.

掃.name: Sweep
掃.meaning: <radical>Fingers</radical>, a <radical>broom</radical>, a <radical>lid</radical> and a <radical>towel</radical>. Grab the broom: <kanji>sweep</kanji>.
掃.reading: Sweep up a soda can, そう. 掃除 is cleaning.

掘.name: Dig
掘.reading: Dig up a boot, くつ. 掘る is to dig.

軟.name: Soft
軟.meaning: A <radical>car</radical> and a <radical>yawn</radical>. A car with sleepy suspension: <kanji>soft</kanji>.
軟.reading: Soft as naan, なん. 柔軟 is flexible.

沈.name: Sink
沈.meaning: <radical>Water</radical> over a <radical>lid</radical> on <radical>legs</radical>. The legs disappear under the lid of water: <kanji>sink</kanji>.
沈.reading: Up to your chin, ちん. 沈む is to sink.

凍.name: Freeze
凍.meaning: <radical>Ice</radical> in the <radical>east</radical>. The east wind makes it <kanji>freeze</kanji>.
凍.reading: A toad, とう, freezes solid. 冷凍 is freezing; 凍る to freeze.

恋.name: Romance
恋.meaning: A <radical>top hat</radical> with things <radical>slide</radical>ing off a <radical>barb</radical>, over a <radical>heart</radical>. Your hat flies off and your heart melts: <kanji>romance</kanji>.
恋.reading: Seen through rose-tinted lenses, れん. 恋愛 is romance; 恋 love (こい).

郊.name: Suburbs
郊.meaning: <radical>Mix</radical> and <radical>town</radical>. Where town mixes with country: the <kanji>suburbs</kanji>.
郊.reading: A koala, こう, commutes from there. 郊外 is suburbs.

腰.name: Waist
腰.meaning: <radical>Moon</radical> (flesh) and <radical>need</radical>. The body part you need most: your <kanji>waist</kanji>.
腰.reading: Spin a yo-yo, よう, round it. 腰 is こし.

踊.name: Dance
踊.meaning: A <radical>foot</radical>, <radical>mama</radical> and <radical>use</radical>. Mama uses her feet: <kanji>dance</kanji>.
踊.reading: おどる: "oh, door!" she dances out of it. 踊る is to dance.

珍.name: Rare
珍.meaning: A <radical>king</radical>, a <radical>person</radical> and <radical>hair</radical>. A king with wild hair: <kanji>rare</kanji>.
珍.reading: With a pointy chin, ちん. 珍しい is rare.

喫.name: Consume
喫.meaning: A <radical>mouth</radical> and a <radical>pledge</radical>. Promise to <kanji>consume</kanji> it all.
喫.reading: A kitten, きつ, laps it up. 喫茶店 is a café.

溶.name: Melt
溶.meaning: <radical>Water</radical> and <radical>contain</radical>. Water that holds everything: <kanji>melt</kanji> it in.
溶.reading: Stir with a yo-yo, よう. 溶ける is to melt.

涙.name: Tears
涙.reading: なみだ: "nah, me? Dad!" you sob. 涙 is tears.

匹.name: Small Animal
匹.meaning: <radical>Legs</radical> <radical>hiding</radical> in a box. A <kanji>small animal</kanji>. It counts them.
匹.reading: ひき: it goes "hic!" 一匹 is one animal (いっぴき).

鋭.name: Sharp
鋭.meaning: <radical>Gold</radical>, <radical>eight</radical> and an <radical>older brother</radical>. Big brother's metal blade: <kanji>sharp</kanji>.
鋭.reading: Sharp as an ace, えい. 鋭い is sharp.

塗.name: Paint
塗.meaning: <radical>Water</radical>, <radical>surplus</radical> and <radical>dirt</radical>. Mix spare mud with water and <kanji>paint</kanji> the wall.
塗.reading: With your toe, と. 塗る is to paint.

軒.name: Eaves
軒.meaning: A <radical>car</radical> and something <radical>dry</radical>. Park the car where it stays dry: under the <kanji>eaves</kanji>. It counts houses.
軒.reading: Ken's house, けん. 一軒 is one house.

叫.name: Shout
叫.meaning: A <radical>mouth</radical> and a <radical>stick</radical> with a twist. You bang the stick and <kanji>shout</kanji>.
叫.reading: さけぶ: "sake, boo!" you shout at the bar. 叫ぶ is to shout.

乾.name: Dry
乾.meaning: A <radical>cross</radical>, <radical>early</radical> and <radical>beg</radical>. Early sun: the laundry begs to <kanji>dry</kanji>.
乾.reading: A kangaroo, かん, hangs it out. 乾杯 is cheers; 乾く to dry.

祈.name: Pray
祈.meaning: An <radical>altar</radical> and an <radical>axe</radical>. Lay down your axe at the altar and <kanji>pray</kanji>.
祈.reading: Unlock it with a key, き. 祈る is to pray.

汗.name: Sweat
汗.meaning: <radical>Water</radical> on something <radical>dry</radical>. Drops on dry skin: <kanji>sweat</kanji>.
汗.reading: あせ: "ah, set" in the sauna. 汗 is sweat.

湿.name: Damp
湿.meaning: <radical>Water</radical>, the <radical>sun</radical> and <radical>business</radical>. Hot sun on wet ground: <kanji>damp</kanji>.
湿.reading: Your shirt, しつ, sticks to you. 湿気 is humidity.

瓶.name: Bottle
瓶.meaning: Something <radical>dry</radical> and a <radical>tile</radical>. Fired clay: a <kanji>bottle</kanji>.
瓶.reading: Toss it in the bin, びん. 瓶 is a bottle.

咲.name: Bloom
咲.meaning: A <radical>mouth</radical> and <radical>heaven</radical>. Petals open to the sky: <kanji>bloom</kanji>.
咲.reading: さく: they burst from a sack. 咲く is to bloom.

缶.name: Can
缶.reading: A kangaroo, かん, kicks it. 缶 is a can; 缶詰 canned food.

隻.name: Vessel
隻.meaning: A <radical>turkey</radical> on a <radical>stool</radical>. A single bird perched: one of a pair. It counts ships: <kanji>vessel</kanji>.
隻.reading: Loaded with a sack of rice, せき. 一隻 is one ship.

脂.name: Fat
脂.reading: A sheep, し, has plenty. 脂肪 is fat.

肌.name: Skin
肌.meaning: <radical>Moon</radical> (flesh) and a <radical>table</radical>. Smooth as a table: <kanji>skin</kanji>.
肌.reading: はだ: "ha, darling", you have lovely skin. 肌 is skin.

鈍.name: Dull
鈍.reading: A donkey, どん, is slow. 鈍い is dull.

泥.name: Mud
泥.meaning: <radical>Water</radical> and a <radical>nun</radical>. The nun slips in the <kanji>mud</kanji>.
泥.reading: Picking daisies, でい. 泥 is どろ; 泥棒 a thief.

隅.name: Corner
隅.meaning: A <radical>building</radical>, the <radical>sun</radical>, a <radical>helmet</radical> and a <radical>rice paddy</radical>. The sun can't reach the <kanji>corner</kanji>.
隅.reading: すみ: "sue me", you sulk in the corner. 隅 is a corner.

辛.name: Spicy
辛.meaning: <radical>Stand</radical> over a <radical>cross</radical>. Like a needle on your tongue: <kanji>spicy</kanji>.
辛.reading: Your shins, しん, sweat. 辛い is spicy (からい) or painful (つらい).

磨.name: Polish
磨.meaning: <radical>Hemp</radical> and a <radical>stone</radical>. Rub stone with hemp cloth: <kanji>polish</kanji>.
磨.reading: Your ma does it, ま. 磨く is to polish; 歯磨き toothpaste.

姓.name: Surname
姓.meaning: A <radical>woman</radical> and <radical>life</radical>. The name you're born with: <kanji>surname</kanji>.
姓.reading: Painted on a sail, せい. 姓 is a surname.

筒.name: Tube
筒.meaning: <radical>Bamboo</radical> that's the <radical>same</radical> all the way down. A <kanji>tube</kanji>.
筒.reading: A toad, とう, crawls through. 封筒 is an envelope; 筒 つつ.

粒.name: Grain
粒.reading: Found by a dragon, りゅう. 粒 is a grain (つぶ).

畳.name: Tatami
畳.meaning: A <radical>rice paddy</radical>, a <radical>lid</radical> and <radical>moreover</radical>. Rice straw mats, layer on layer: <kanji>tatami</kanji>.
畳.reading: Laid by a joker, じょう. 六畳 is a six-mat room; 畳む to fold.

膚.name: Skin
膚.meaning: A <radical>tiger</radical> over a <radical>stomach</radical>. Tiger stripes on its belly: <kanji>skin</kanji>.
膚.reading: Kicked by a hoof, ふ. 皮膚 is skin.

濯.name: Rinse
濯.reading: Pinned with a tack, たく, to dry. 洗濯 is laundry.

塔.name: Tower
塔.meaning: <radical>Dirt</radical>, <radical>grass</radical> and <radical>fit</radical>. Earth stacked so it fits: a <kanji>tower</kanji>.
塔.reading: A toad, とう, sits on top. 五重塔 is a five-storey pagoda.

沸.name: Boil
沸.meaning: <radical>Water</radical> with a <radical>bow</radical>, a <radical>slide</radical> and a <radical>stick</radical>. The bubbles twist up: <kanji>boil</kanji>.
沸.reading: わく: "walk" away while it boils. 沸く is to boil. ふつ in compounds.

菓.name: Sweets
菓.reading: Delivered by car, か. お菓子 is sweets.

帽.name: Hat
帽.meaning: A <radical>towel</radical> and a <radical>risk</radical>. Risky sun: wrap a cloth on your head, a <kanji>hat</kanji>.
帽.reading: Stick a bow and arrow, ぼう, in it. 帽子 is a hat.

枯.name: Wither
枯.reading: A cobra, こ, sheds under it. 枯れる is to wither.

涼.name: Cool
涼.meaning: <radical>Water</radical> in the <radical>capital</radical>. Fountains keep the city <kanji>cool</kanji>.
涼.reading: After the rodeo, りょう. 涼しい is cool.

符.name: Token
符.meaning: <radical>Bamboo</radical> and <radical>attach</radical>. A bamboo tag you attach: a <kanji>token</kanji>.
符.reading: Stamped by a hoof, ふ. 切符 is a ticket (ぷ).

憎.name: Hate
憎.reading: にくい: "nicky" is hateful. 憎い is hateful; 憎む to hate.

肯.name: Agree
肯.meaning: <radical>Stop</radical> over <radical>moon</radical> (flesh). Stop and nod your head: <kanji>agree</kanji>.
肯.reading: A koala, こう, nods. 肯定 is affirmation.

燥.name: Dry Up
燥.meaning: <radical>Fire</radical>, <radical>goods</radical> and a <radical>tree</radical>. Fire under the woodpile: it will <kanji>dry up</kanji>.
燥.reading: Like an empty soda can, そう. 乾燥 is dryness.

畜.name: Livestock
畜.meaning: <radical>Mysterious</radical> over a <radical>rice paddy</radical>. Strange beasts in the fields: <kanji>livestock</kanji>.
畜.reading: A chick, ちく, among them. 家畜 is livestock.

挟.name: Pinch
挟.meaning: <radical>Fingers</radical>, <radical>two</radical> <radical>person</radical>s and someone <radical>big</radical>. Squeezed in the middle: <kanji>pinch</kanji>.
挟.reading: はさむ: "has a moo"-ing cow stuck between. 挟む is to sandwich.

曇.name: Cloudy
曇.meaning: The <radical>sun</radical> over a <radical>cloud</radical>. The sun is covered: <kanji>cloudy</kanji>.
曇.reading: くもる: "cool, more clouds". 曇り is cloudy.

滴.name: Drip
滴.meaning: <radical>Water</radical>, a <radical>top hat</radical>, a <radical>helmet</radical> and something <radical>old</radical>. Water drips off the old helmet: <kanji>drip</kanji>.
滴.reading: Onto a tech gadget, てき. 水滴 is a water drop.

伺.name: Visit
伺.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> and a <radical>director</radical>. You humbly <kanji>visit</kanji> the director.
伺.reading: うかがう: "ooh, car, go!" you set off politely. 伺う is to visit or ask (humble).
